About Us

Vennila Educational Academy is committed to providing quality education that helps students achieve their academic goals. Located in Kodungaiyur, Chennai, we specialize in tuition for classes 1st to 12th standard.

Our experienced faculty members use innovative teaching methods to make learning engaging and effective. We focus on concept clarity, problem-solving skills, and exam preparation with regular assessments.

Join us and experience excellence in education!

Mrs. Stella Tamilarasi

Proprietor & Founder

🌟 Vision & Mission

Welcome to Vennila Educational Academy! It is my privilege to lead an institution dedicated to nurturing young minds and shaping future leaders. Our academy was founded with a vision to provide quality education that goes beyond textbooks and examinations.

At Vennila Educational Academy, we believe in holistic development of every student. Our mission is to create a learning environment where students can discover their potential, develop critical thinking skills, and build a strong foundation for their future endeavors.

Our ambitious vision is to expand to 100 branches across the region, making quality education accessible to students everywhere. Our mission is simple yet powerful: to help every student achieve 100% marks through dedicated teaching and personalized attention.

💼 Our Commitment to Excellence

We are committed to maintaining the highest standards of education through our experienced faculty, modern teaching methodologies, and personalized attention to each student. Our small batch sizes ensure that every child receives the guidance they need to excel academically.

Since our establishment, we have been dedicated to creating an environment where learning is not just about passing exams, but about understanding concepts deeply and developing a genuine love for knowledge. We focus on building strong fundamentals that serve our students throughout their academic journey and beyond.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Building a Learning Community

At Vennila Educational Academy, we don't just teach students – we build relationships with families. We understand that education is a partnership between teachers, students, and parents. Our open-door policy ensures that parents are always informed about their child's progress and can actively participate in their educational journey.

We take pride in our track record of helping students achieve outstanding results in board examinations and competitive entrance tests. Many of our students have gone on to pursue their dreams in prestigious institutions, and we continue to support them as they grow.

🎯 Our Values & Approach

We believe in:

Quality over Quantity: Small batch sizes ensure individual attention to every student.
Concept Clarity: Deep understanding rather than rote memorization.
Regular Assessment: Continuous monitoring of student progress through tests and feedback.
Personalized Teaching: Adapting our methods to suit each student's learning style.
Character Building: Developing not just academic excellence but also discipline and values.

💫 My Personal Message

I invite you to join our academic family and experience the difference that dedicated teaching and genuine care can make in a student's educational journey. Every student who walks through our doors is treated as part of our extended family, and we invest ourselves fully in their success.

Together, let us work towards building a brighter future for your child. Let us help them not just achieve 100% marks, but also develop into confident, capable individuals ready to take on any challenge.

- Mrs. Stella Tamilarasi
